title.zh: Dessa: the most authentic full-duplex speech model ever built

current_state.zh: Block's Dessa is presented as the most authentic full-duplex speech model yet, combining low-latency expressive conversation with local inference on a MacBook Pro M4 Max and training on just one NVIDIA GB200 NVL72.
